verdict.rationale: The evidence shows built-in AI summaries and automatic labeling, which are passive AI features rather than an in-product assistant that accepts delegated tasks. The documented MCP server lets external assistants like Claude or Cursor act on the mailbox, which is an integration with outside agents, not a built-in assistant. No evidence shows a native in-app assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
